name: Tend
description: A calm, weather-minded template for therapists, counselors and small group practices. A cool mist canvas, periwinkle skies drawn in code with one apricot sun, split headlines that turn into an italic serif halfway through, and a letter-style introduction under a gallery-label portrait. Its signature is the specialties typeset as an inner-weather forecast. It also includes a plain fee sheet with insurance and sliding-scale details, the 988 crisis line on every page, and a book-a-free-consultation button at both ends of the page.
